name: xtool
description: Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, macOS.
one_liner: A tool that lets you build, sign, and install iPhone apps from a Windows or Linux computer, without owning a Mac.
buyer: A small cross-platform dev shop or solo iOS developer who doesn't want to buy or rent a Mac just to ship an iPhone app.
business_use_cases: A solo developer builds and ships an iOS app entirely from a Windows laptop, skipping the cost of a Mac or a cloud Mac rental service.
A startup's CI/CD pipeline builds and signs iOS apps on cheap Linux build servers instead of paying for Mac-based CI runners.
A cross-platform app agency uses it to let non-Mac engineers contribute directly to the iOS build without needing their own Apple hardware.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid hosted CI service specifically for teams who want iOS builds without any Mac infrastructure.
Sell setup/consulting packages helping agencies migrate their iOS build pipeline off Mac hardware.

steal_this: Offer a one-weekend 'ship your first iOS app without buying a Mac' setup service for hobbyist Windows/Linux developers, charging a flat fee to configure xtool and sign their first build.
